key_insight: VOPD turns sparse verifier feedback into dense, verifier-grounded next-token supervision, coupling outcome verification with teacher guidance.
engineering_relevance: For mathematical-reasoning model training, VOPD offers a way to improve performance and learning efficiency beyond standard on-policy distillation.
method: Express teacher supervision and verifier feedback in a shared implicit-reward space.
Project verifier preference onto the teacher’s implicit-reward direction.
Rao–Blackwellize over the full vocabulary to supervise even unsampled next-token actions.
evidence_signal: Across two teacher–student configurations and eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, the abstract reports consistent gains in final performance and learning efficiency over vanilla OPD and other on-policy distillation baselines.
watch_item: Full-vocabulary teacher feedback may add computational overhead; the abstract does not quantify this cost.
